context: Tests whether the agent splits unrelated changes into separate atomic commits, stages files individually rather than using git add -A or git add ., uses the correct Conventional Commits format for each commit message, includes a body for non-obvious changes, and validates the result.

checklist.name: Atomic commits
checklist.description: The auth middleware fix and the dashboard loading spinner are in two separate commits, not combined into one

checklist.name: No bulk staging
checklist.description: The commit-log-full.txt or any shell history / script does NOT show 'git add .' or 'git add -A'; files are staged individually

checklist.name: Commit type: fix
checklist.description: The auth-related commit uses the 'fix' type prefix (e.g. fix(auth): ...)

checklist.name: Commit type: feat
checklist.description: The dashboard loading spinner commit uses the 'feat' type prefix (e.g. feat(dashboard): ...)

checklist.name: Imperative mood
checklist.description: Both commit message headers use imperative mood (e.g. 'add', 'fix', 'handle') not past tense (e.g. 'added', 'fixed')

checklist.name: Lowercase header start
checklist.description: The description portion of both commit headers starts with a lowercase letter

checklist.name: No trailing period
checklist.description: Neither commit header ends with a period

checklist.name: Header length <= 72
checklist.description: Both commit headers are at most 72 characters in total length

checklist.name: Body for fix commit
checklist.description: The auth fix commit includes a body explaining the non-obvious reasoning (e.g. describes the timing issue, race condition, or why the fix was needed)

checklist.name: Blank line before body
checklist.description: The fix commit's body is separated from the header by exactly one blank line

checklist.name: Validation step
checklist.description: commit-log.txt or commit-log-full.txt exists and contains output from git log, showing at least 2 commits

checklist.name: No WIP commits
checklist.description: None of the commit messages contain 'WIP', 'wip', 'temp', or 'Temp'
